result.instructions: Tools for MiJornada, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees worked more than 40 hours in the week of 2026-10-05?"; "List the absences approved for the team in November 2026."; "How many project hours did we log against client Acme last month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MiJornada data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mijornada_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mijornada_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mijornada_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mijornada_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mijornada_get_account
tools.title: Get account and key
tools.description: Return the company (name, time zone) and the key this server uses: its scopes and purpose. Use it to test the connection. MiJornada API: GET /me.

tools.name: mijornada_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the people in the company, with name, email, employee code, worksite and status. Filter by exact email, employee code, worksite or status. MiJornada API: GET /employees (scope employees:read).

employee_code.description: The code the company gave the employee.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: Return one employee by id. MiJornada API: GET /employees/{id} (scope employees:read).

tools.name: mijornada_list_worksites
tools.title: List worksites
tools.description: List the company's workplaces (worksites). Use the ids as worksite_id filters. MiJornada API: GET /worksites (scope employees:read).

tools.name: mijornada_list_workdays
tools.title: List working days
tools.description: List one row per person and day: worked minutes, breaks, first clock-in, last clock-out, and whether an approved correction applies. These are the figures in force, so use this for payroll. Window: up to 93 days. Pass include_timeline to add each day's movements. MiJornada API: GET /workdays (scope time:read).

from.description: First day, in the company time zone.

to.description: Last day, included. At most 93 days after from.

include_timeline.description: Add the day's clock movements to each row.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_list_time_events
tools.title: List clock events
tools.description: List the raw clock events (in, break, out) in time order. Approved corrections do not change these rows: use mijornada_list_workdays for the figures in force. Window: up to 93 days. MiJornada API: GET /time-events (scope time:read).

from.description: First day, in the company time zone.

to.description: Last day, included. At most 93 days after from.

source.description: Where the clock event was made.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List vacations and other absences that overlap the range: type, dates, state and days. Medical leave appears as a plain absence, with no reason or documents. Window: up to a year. MiJornada API: GET /absences (scope absences:read).

from.description: First day, in the company time zone.

to.description: Last day, included. At most a year after from.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients the company works for. Archived clients are left out unless include_archived is true. MiJornada API: GET /clients (scope projects:read).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the jobs, sites or assignments the company tracks hours against. Filter by state or client. Rates and money budgets appear only when the key has billing:read. MiJornada API: GET /projects (scope projects:read).

client_id.description: Only projects of this client (the MiJornada id).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_list_project_time
tools.title: List project hours
tools.description: List minutes per person, day, project and activity. A day's lines add up to the minutes worked that day; time on no project has no project_id. Window: up to 93 days. MiJornada API: GET /project-time (scope projects:read).

from.description: First day, in the company time zone.

to.description: Last day, included. At most 93 days after from.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: mijornada_list_valuations
tools.title: List statements to invoice
tools.description: List issued statements to invoice: approved hours, materials and other lines, priced, with VAT per line. They are not invoices and have no tax validity. Drafts are not listed. Window: up to a year of issue dates. MiJornada API: GET /valuations (scope billing:read).

to.description: Last issue date, included. At most a year after from.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.
